scope: Exact necessary canonical definition context only; no target proof or root source/topology verdict. Character/raw UTF8/LF spans are exact, including their terminal LF.

definitions.name: ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian
definitions.literalLF:
noncomputable
def stdGaussian : Measure E :=
  (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E) ↦ gaussianReal 0 1)).map
    (fun x ↦ ∑ i, x i • stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E i)
definitions.context: Namespace ProbabilityTheory; E finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its given Borel measurable structure. This is the actual map of independent gaussianReal0 1 coordinates through a canonical orthonormal basis, not a caller law certificate.

definitions.name: MeasureTheory.Integrable
definitions.context: Integrability is AEStronglyMeasurable plus finite norm integral, returned as a conclusion.

definitions.name: MeasureTheory.HasFiniteIntegral
definitions.context: Fixed real-valued nonnegative exponential and actual stdGaussian; no assumed integrability.

definitions.name: MeasureTheory.integral
definitions.literalLF:
irreducible_def integral {_ : MeasurableSpace α} (μ : Measure α) (f : α → G) : G :=
  if _ : CompleteSpace G then
    if hf : Integrable f μ then L1.integral (hf.toL1 f) else 0
  else 0
definitions.context: Bochner totalization is explicit. Codomain is complete real numbers, and producer separately proves Integrable; no default-zero branch may substitute for the moment.

definitions.name: Real.rpow
definitions.literalLF:
noncomputable def rpow (x y : ℝ) :=
  ((x : ℂ) ^ (y : ℂ)).re
definitions.context: The base is exactly positive3. Exponent is real dimension/2, not natural-number division; dim0 gives3^0=1.

definitions.name: Module.finrank
definitions.literalLF:
noncomputable def finrank (R M : Type*) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] : ℕ :=
  Cardinal.toNat (Module.rank R M)
definitions.context: Namespace Module. Fixed field real and FiniteDimensional E; cardinal rank is finite, includes genuine dimension0.

definitions.name: FiniteDimensional
definitions.literalLF:
abbrev FiniteDimensional (K V : Type*) [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] :=
  Module.Finite K V
definitions.context: Pure finite-dimensional carrier information; Module.Finite means finitely generated real module. No analytic estimate is bundled.

definitions.name: BorelSpace
definitions.literalLF:
class BorelSpace (α : Type*) [TopologicalSpace α] [MeasurableSpace α] : Prop where
  /-- The measurable sets are exactly the Borel-measurable sets. -/
  measurable_eq : ‹MeasurableSpace α› = borel α
definitions.context: The measurable structure equals the Borel sigma algebra. Standard typing for the finite-dimensional Gaussian law, not an extra regularity estimate on data.

definitions.name: ENNReal.ofReal
definitions.literalLF: protected def ofReal (r : Real) : ℝ≥0∞ := r.toNNReal
definitions.context: Namespace ENNReal. Real-to-nonnegative extended real conversion; source hq internally implies d>=2 and positive finite reciprocal threshold.

definitions.name: EuclideanSpace
definitions.literalLF:
abbrev EuclideanSpace (𝕜 : Type*) (n : Type*) : Type _ :=
  PiLp 2 fun _ : n => 𝕜
definitions.context: Actual L2 Euclidean norm on Fin(q+1), not the default norm of a raw function.

definitions.name: PiLp
definitions.literalLF:
abbrev PiLp (p : ℝ≥0∞) {ι : Type*} (α : ι → Type*) : Type _ :=
  WithLp p (∀ i : ι, α i)
definitions.context: EuclideanSpace specializes the actual product norm to p=2.
